scope: The original 12 records and all 14 original fields remain available; blank buyer template, no source customer data

fields.A №: Реестр удержаний A; Условия возврата A
fields.B act number; C act date: Реестр удержаний B: one act identifier including its date
fields.I planned/actual event date: Условия возврата D; status I confirms whether event occurred
fields.J date letter sent; K request status; N: Условия возврата L (dates sent/delivered separately labelled)

additions.Реестр удержаний B3: Fixed as-of date, no volatile TODAY
additions.Реестр удержаний F: Other confirmed discharge, disjoint from cash refunds
additions.Реестр удержаний G: Validated remaining principal, one subtraction of each category
additions.Реестр удержаний H: Refund amount after confirmation of conditions and deadline
additions.Реестр удержаний I: Business eligibility or specific missing evidence
additions.Условия возврата E:I: Contract return mode, required delivery, verified due date and basis, confirmed conditions
additions.Условия возврата K; M: Credit evidence and other discharge date

deadline: Manually verify the contract and applicable calendar; no universal seven-day or holiday algorithm is assumed
operation_deduplication: Each operation classified once by the user with evidence; no bank transaction ID importer or automatic identity reconciliation is claimed
formula_editing_model: Source had no sheet protection; retained. Gray formula cells are labelled; native calculations check their intact exported formulas
print: Main A4 landscape; conditions A3 landscape. Final acceptance depends on actual native exported pages
